notes: Booklet pages are low-detail; many placements are inferred from small drawings.

The booklet builds two separate things: the Squidman minifigure (page 2) and the ship (pages 3-11). b1 (green '100' banknote tile) is held in Squidman's hand and never touches the ship, so it is deliberately a separate group. The minifigures are not in the parts list, so nothing in the graph can connect it. The ship is the one connected model (b2-b33).
Hull build: b2/b3 are the two black 2x4 plates stacked offset; b3 treated as on top of b2, with b2's two left studs exposed for the Technic brick b7. The stacking direction is a guess.
Wedges b16/b18 hang on the side studs of the two 1x4 stud-side bricks; attachments to sides are listed as other_joins, not rests_on.
Sticker sheet b20 is applied to wedges and the flag; the ship's front black bump is a sticker.
Rear sub-assembly (b26-b33) from p9-10 is attached to the hull on page 10 via b27 hinge finger and b4 bar. Exact bracket/wedge links are inferred.
Positions of the two 2540 plates b12/b13 and the 3794b jumper b11 on top of the hull are inferred.
